description: Returns one owned address by its permanent 9-digit code as {ok, address}. Use it when the user already provided a code; use list_addresses to discover codes. Fails clearly if the code is invalid or not owned by the connected account. Read-only; does not mutate.

code.description: Anwani permanent 9-digit address code (digits 1–9 only). Example: 365131449

name: get_address

address.description: One owned Anwani address (no internal user IDs).
